title: Blog Article Template
prompt: Create an article template with a title, author/time information, section headings, and a related link.
objective: Create a readable article skeleton with an article, header, time, and section.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: articles, sections, metadata.
hints: Use article for self-contained content, time for a date or duration, and headings to describe the sections.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.explanation: Reference approach: Use article for self-contained content, time for a date or duration, and headings to describe the sections. Required structural evidence: <article>, <time, <section>, <h1>.

grading_method: server-side required-string smoke check plus human review for quality
retry_policy: Allow retries; only the first successful completion for this activity may award base XP. Incorrect submissions do not award XP.
status_note: Reference solution and grading configuration remain in backend content files; public exercise endpoints must omit them.
